summary.text: Man soul is the scale that names a soul's strength: a soul strengthened a hundred times over is hundred man soul, the limit for normal people, with thousand man soul and ten thousand man soul named above it.

claims.text: Strengthening a soul a hundred times over is called hundred man soul, and normal people can strengthen their soul no further than that. It is also the extreme limit: a little more and the soul explodes and disperses completely, after which the flesh rots away to a skeleton.

Fang Yuan reaches the hundred mark by stepping on gutstones and stops there, since one more guts Gu would kill him before he could use Spring Autumn Cicada. He counts on other soul path Gu such as divine soul Gu, dragon soul Gu and moon soul Gu to refine his soul, so that he can break through hundred man soul to reach thousand man soul or even ten thousand man soul. Simply strengthening the soul is a quantitative advantage, and only refinement and purification give a qualitative one.
A hundred beast wolf king’s soul resists strongly against Fang Yuan’s hundred man soul and still fails utterly.

Fang Yuan has no fear of a soul contest with a wind wolf king because of his hundred man soul. Onlookers guess from his enslavement skill that he has a hundred man soul, and one of them retorts that Jiang Bao Ya, Yang Po Ying and Ma Zun all have thousand man souls.
Suppressing wolf king after wolf king with his hundred man soul leaves his soul more impatient and impulsive, and after a rest the soul stabilizes and the negative emotions vanish.

Past hundred man soul a soul can be raised to thousand man soul or ten thousand man soul, and ten thousand man soul is not the limit, since hundred million man soul also exists. Fang Yuan reasons that in theory the soul can strengthen without limit, and that Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, who created soul path, definitely surpassed hundred million man soul.

A hundred man soul refined by nine wolf soul Gu stays human shaped but gains wolf ears, wolf eyes, hair down to the waist, a thinner body and a sharper nose, and its colour turns from pale white to a hint of grey white as it condenses. Fang Yuan expects the soul to become half man and half wolf once the wolf soul Gu are used up, and calls that wolfman soul, many times stronger than an ordinary hundred man soul.
The hundred man soul then changes thoroughly into wolfman soul, and Fang Yuan gains the aura of a wolf, so that wolf kings take him for one of their species.
After guts Gu raise the soul to thousand man soul, the effect of the wolf soul Gu thins out and the soul recovers the appearance of a normal soul.

A wolf soul later fuses into his thousand man soul and gives it long wolf ears, a body thinner than Fang Yuan’s and a sharper nose, and Fang Yuan reckons his soul is around thirty percent wolfman soul.
Man Hao reports that a secret check at the banquet found the soul of the man he knows as the Wolf King Chang Shan Yin no longer at thousand man soul but down to hundred man soul.

Chang Shan Yin had thousand man soul back when he wiped out Ha Tu Gu’s group of bandits, and impermanence bones make Fang Yuan’s body firm enough that containing thousand man soul is no longer a problem for him.
At Dang Hun Mountain Fang Yuan’s soul becomes over five times stronger than before, and he notes that a large gap to thousand man soul remains.
Fang Yuan judges that the final step of a land spirit’s Gu refinement, a light ball that inflates and contracts, takes control that needs at least thousand man soul.

After days of strengthening with guts Gu at Dang Hun Mountain, Fang Yuan’s soul reaches thousand man soul, more solid and dense than before. Thousand man soul is the signature trademark of an enslavement expert, and Chang Shan Yin had it.

Wei Xin says that after twenty years of near daily cultivation he has reached only eight hundred man crabman soul, and Dong Fang Yu Liang says he gained thousand man soul with coptis rhizome Gu and slow slicing Gu at the cost of ten years.

Normal Gu Masters need about twenty years to cultivate their soul to thousand man soul, and geniuses helped by their clans or seniors can halve that, while Fang Yuan does it in under half a year with the guts Gu of Dang Hun Mountain.

Gu Masters with at least five hundred man soul feel the pressure of the three hearts combination soul killer move, which Fang Yuan reads as the level of one thousand four hundred man soul, while those under five hundred man soul sense nothing. The soul explosion injures Fang Yuan’s soul from thousand man soul down to eight hundred man soul, and after days of recuperation it recovers only to nine hundred man soul, which cannot match the other side.
After the four arm earth king killer move he has heavy internal bleeding, and his soul has weakened to five hundred man soul.
Burning soul bursting luck expends his soul foundation several times until it stands at only hundred man soul level.
Using split soul drops his soul foundation from ten million man soul to nine million man soul.
Corrosion in a dream realm drops his ten million man soul to million man soul.
Guts Gu used without regard for expense raise it back to ten million man soul.

Spectral Soul’s true inheritance classifies soul foundation from low to high as single man soul, ten man soul, hundred man soul, on through million man soul and ten million man soul to hundred million man soul. Ten man soul means a soul foundation equal to the total of ten grown men’s souls. When Fang Yuan reaches hundred million man soul, he expects his soul to turn from phantom to solid.

Fang Yuan raises his soul by using guts Gu to strengthen it, tempering it in Luo Po Valley like iron to remove impurities, and then sleeping to rest the soul and shed agitation, and the three steps repeated lift his soul foundation like a rocket. His soul foundation stands at three million man soul before one session and stabilizes at million man soul after the tempering of Luo Po wind and bewilderment fog.
Fang Yuan notes that past million man soul each cultivation session raises his soul by five hundred thousand man soul, and reckons that ten million man soul would take him half a year.
His soul foundation reaches fifty million man soul, so condensed that it shows signs of turning solid.
It rises to ninety million man soul, only a slight distance from hundred million man soul.
Fang Yuan reaches hundred million man soul and his soul turns from phantom to solid and interferes with the material world.
He goes on to two hundred million man soul, and his soul is even more solid and lifelike, with tougher limbs.

Hundred million man soul is the limit of a human soul: at that mark the soul solidifies and can interfere directly with the real world instead of staying an illusory body, yet it is still fragile. The narration places that limit in the time before Red Lotus Demon Venerable, whose breaking of fate Gu also broke it, though no one found the way to advance and a million man soul was already amazing in those days. Fang Yuan, at ninety million man soul, expects the soul cores of one trip to carry him to hundred million man soul, and notes that this is only midway in the soul cultivation records of Spectral Soul’s true inheritance.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable found the way beyond hundred million man soul, and above it lies desolate soul. Once a soul crosses into desolate soul, the soul alone has the strength of a desolate level soul beast, and cultivating it to the limit gives hundred million desolate soul, the peak of soul cultivation and the limit the world can contain. Fang Yuan has personally witnessed that level in the giant form of Spectral Soul’s main body, recorded as three headed thousand arms demon soul, and reaching it means quasi rank nine battle strength.
According to Spectral Soul’s true inheritance, a thousand dao marks lie on the soul once it reaches desolate soul.
Fang Yuan expects that with desolate soul he can match most desolate beasts with his soul alone.

Fang Yuan sends his hundred million man soul into a formation modified from a soul path technique recorded in Shadow Sect true inheritance, his soul crushes a processed desolate beast soul core inside it, and once the fog it releases has thinned away he has desolate soul. His human soul could float, but his desolate soul cannot fly and relies on Gu worms, and the Shadow Sect records say a human soul that reaches desolate soul cannot fly because humans are innately unable to.
His soul then progresses from one desolate soul through three, five and eight desolate soul to ten desolate soul.
With a desolate soul, exploring dream realms becomes much easier, since a human soul would take much heavier injuries.

The supreme soul path cultivation method that Fang Yuan gained with Shadow Sect’s true inheritance divides soul cultivation into the human soul layer, from single man soul to hundred million man soul, and the desolate soul layer, which climbs from ten desolate soul through hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand, million and ten million desolate soul to hundred million desolate soul. Fang Yuan’s soul stands at sixty million desolate soul.
A human soul that becomes desolate soul gains beast nature, more exactly heaven nature, and at hundred million desolate soul the proportion of human nature is very low.
